note:
BH-7421. pool_rest_read cuts one GitHub read of the pool (PR, branch head, hold, repo probe) after this many seconds. A cut read answers with no HTTP code. The first unreadable PR read in a tick stops PR reads for that project for the rest of the tick and raises ONE alert per project per hour (flags/alerted-pool-pr-unreadable-

). Settings row `lane.fly-pool.pool_gh_read_timeout_s`. 0 = off: no per-read limit.
